name: Clínica de Masajes Calientes
source: The hard life of a worker changes when he decides to do something as trivial as going to a massage clinic. There he discovers that he can do more than just relieve his back pain. Thanks to his four hot masseuses, he will rise from the ashes.
translation: 一名打工人的苦逼生活，因他一时兴起走进一家按摩诊所的微不足道之举而彻底改变。在那里他才发现，自己能解决的可远不止背痛而已。多亏了店里四位火辣诱人的女技师，他即将浴火重生。
